acceptance: Red first: a braked pool reports cause operator_stop even when its launch cap is also reached.
Docs: the orchestrator package note changes in STE; 100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Wire the loop-stop brake (and evolve wave stop) into PoolConfig.Halted so the pool sees the stop; keep the cause order. Red test: a pool past its cap that is then braked reports operator_stop.
summary: Wave 171, 2026-11-14 04:19Z: after `evolve wave stop` (loop-stop brake), LOOP_ORCH_POOL_IDLE and LOOP_ORCH_POOL_UNDERFILLED carried cause=run_cap. go/internal/orchestrator/idle_cause.go checks t.Stopped before t.Capped, and fleet.pool.stopped() reads PoolConfig.Halted, so the brake path does not reach Halted while the run cap (RunMaxLanes default = orchestratorRunLanesPerSlot x count, policy/fleet_orchestrator.go:83) was already hit. PQ8 then attributes operator-stop drain time to the run cap. Plan: docs/plans/pipeline-health-indexes-2026-11.md (H1, D2).
